column1: # smoke.tsv -- SMOKE TEST TABLE, NOT the measurement case list.
# This exists only to prove the dumper runs end to end on a machine: that the
# case table loads, appl_init/graf_handle/v_opnvwk succeed, the reset and the
# poison work, and a well-formed VDI.BIN comes out. It is deliberately NOT
# cases/vdi.tsv: spec section 10 requires the real first case list to come from
# a trap-dispatcher log of QED under NewTOS, not from a hand-picked selection.
# Nothing measured with this table is a conformance result.
# Opcodes and their inputs are taken from the EmuTOS jump table
# (vdi/vdi_main.c:32-106) and from each handler, not from memory. Only calls
# with deterministic results are listed: vq_mouse (124) and vq_key_s (128)
# read live input devices and would differ between two runs on one machine.
